title: Montana Code Annotated, Title 49 (Human Rights), Chapter 2 (Illegal Discrimination), Part 3 - maternity leave and reinstatement after pregnancy-related leave (ss. 49-2-310, 49-2-311)
source_id: Mont. Code Ann. ss. 49-2-310 to 49-2-311 (Title 49, ch. 2, pt. 3)
verified_how: Fetched the Title 39, ch. 7 parts index first, which shows 'Part 2. Maternity Leave (Renumbered and Repealed)' - the old Maternity Leave Act location. Then fetched https://mca.legmt.gov/bills/mca/title_0490/chapter_0020/part_0030/sections_index.html (HTTP 200): 'Part 3. Prohibited Discriminatory Practices - Table of Contents, Title 49, Chapter 2, MCA', listing '49-2-310 Maternity leave -- unlawful acts of employers' and '49-2-311 Reinstatement to job following pregnancy-related leave of absence', neither marked repealed. Also fetched the section page /title_0490/chapter_0020/part_0030/section_0100/0490-0020-0030-0100.html (HTTP 200), whose heading is '49-2-310. Maternity leave -- unlawful acts of employers, MCA' with operative subsections and a History note. Chapter context confirmed at /title_0490/chapter_0020/parts_index.html: 'TITLE 49. HUMAN RIGHTS' / 'CHAPTER 2. ILLEGAL DISCRIMINATION'.
notes: Montana has no general paid-leave, sick-leave or holiday-pay statute for private employment; these renumbered maternity-leave provisions are the only statutory private-sector leave entitlement. Public-employee vacation, sick and holiday leave is separate, in Title 2, ch. 18. The old Title 39, ch. 7, pt. 2 citation is dead (renumbered and repealed) - do not cite it.
